newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices easier at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices easier at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices eased marginally at the weekly auction in Nairobi on Monday, auction officials said on Tuesday.
Brighter and medium BP1s eased by 2-4 U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s lost 2-9 cents. Brighter P DUSTs were irregular following quality while lower mediums PF1s lost upto three cents.
Fannings and Dusts were dearer while BMFs held steady.
Pakistan blenders lent good support while there was strong inquiry from Egypt and Britain.
